primitive.relation: the undirected Cayley graph of a supplied finite group and an arbitrary connection set: Extremal D2ram cayley_adj/cayley_graph and Hamilton U2 cayley_rel/cayley_graph (Sections over gT : finGroupType and S : {set gT}) are GTBase.cayley_graphs.undirected_cayley_rel/undirected_cayley_graph: the carrier gT and the loopless symmetrised relation (x != y) && ((x^-1 * y \in S) || (y^-1 * x \in S)) by conversion (U2's group_scope and D2ram's explicit %g elaborate to the same term); each graph agrees pointwise with undirected_cayley_graph and by the identity isomorphism. The four constructor proofs are related through the graphs they build (eq_diso), never by proof-field equality. No inverse closure, generation, abelianity or order condition is imposed on the primitive; the row guards stay in the rows.

group-carrier-symmetrised.note: the supplied group gT as carrier, any S : {set gT}, the relation (x != y) && ((x^-1 * y \in S) || (y^-1 * x \in S)) (D2ram with explicit %g, U2 under Local Open Scope group_scope: the same elaborated term) and its SGraph; conversion for the relation, pointwise adjacency and the identity isomorphism for the graph
